the price to the public in the offering was $5.75 per firm share. in connection with the offering, the company also granted the underwriters the option, for 30 days, to purchase up to an additional closing for the full exercise of the underwriters’ option occurred on december 15, 2025. the offering, including the full exercise of the underwriters’ option, was made pursuant to an effective
